name: logo-collapse
title: Logo Collapse
description: Logo reveal intro: a stack of photos flicks through and collapses into your logo. A stack of shots flicked through, collapsing into your mark, and the wordmark landing beside it. One card holds the middle of the frame and cuts to the next shot, each smaller and each held for less time than the last, so the sequence winds itself up instead of running at a constant clip. Nothing cross-fades and nothing tweens between shots — the reference holds each card at a fixed size for its whole beat and then cuts, which reads as a stack of prints being dealt rather than as a zoom. At the end of the run the card cuts to a plain tile with the mark on it, the mark overshoots its resting size by a third and settles in three frames, the tile goes, and the mark steps aside twice to make room for the word.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/logos/logo-collapse?ref=cli — images is the stack, split by `|` (not by comma: a data: URL has one of its own); sizes and holds are parallel to it, one entry per shot, sizes as a share of the frame height where `0.48` is square and `0.82x0.461` is 16:9; mark is what the stack collapses into and wordmark the word that lands beside it. background takes an optional plate and accent the colour the two brackets ping in. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette. — 77 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
